name: The British Club
summary: Hilltop club with sport facilities and a UK/Commonwealth social base — compare Bukit Timah access against Hollandse and American Club.
body: The British Club offers family sport and social facilities with a Commonwealth lean. Location and traffic access should be part of your comparison versus American Club (Claymore) or Hollandse Club (often stronger value for west-central lives). Ask for current family category fees, F&B minimums, guest rules, and waitlist status — UK-leaning does not mean automatic entry. Tour at kids’ swim or your weekday sport slot; brochure dinners are a weak predictor of weekly use. Pairs well with BritCham / British Association calendars for newcomers who want community without paying country-club entrance twice.
membershipNotes: Family and individual categories — check joining fees, dues, and current waitlists for your membership type.
